description: Masala Maggi Noodles is a beloved Indian instant noodle dish, elevated with aromatic spices and fresh vegetables for a truly comforting experience. This quick and easy recipe transforms simple Maggi into a flavorful, spicy meal perfect for any time of day. Enjoy the delightful blend of tangy tomatoes, crisp onions, and a kick of green chili, all infused with the iconic Maggi taste.

ingredients.notes: slit or finely chopped, adjust to taste

instructions.title: Prepare the Vegetables
instructions.text: Finely chop the onion, tomato, and capsicum. Slit or finely chop the green chili. Keep the Maggi noodles separated from their Tastemaker sachets.

instructions.title: Saute Aromatics
instructions.text: Heat cooking oil in a pan or kadai over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and green chili. Saute for 2-3 minutes until the onion turns translucent.

instructions.title: Add Vegetables and Spices
instructions.text: Add the chopped tomato, capsicum, and peas to the pan. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the tomatoes soften. Stir in turmeric powder, red chili powder, and garam masala. Cook for another minute, ensuring the spices are well combined with the vegetables.

instructions.title: Introduce Water and Tastemaker
instructions.text: Pour 2 cups of water into the pan. Add both sachets of Maggi Tastemaker. Stir well and bring the mixture to a rolling boil.

instructions.title: Add Maggi Noodles
instructions.text: Break the Maggi noodle cakes into halves or quarters and carefully place them into the boiling water. Make sure the noodles are submerged.

instructions.title: Cook the Noodles
instructions.text: Reduce the heat to medium-low. Let the noodles cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until most of the water is absorbed and the noodles are soft but still slightly soupy, or to your preferred consistency.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Garnish generously with fresh chopped coriander leaves. Serve your hot and spicy Masala Maggi Noodles immediately as a comforting snack or light meal.

tips: For extra flavor, add a pinch of ginger-garlic paste along with the onions in step 2.
Adjust the consistency by adding more or less water; for a drier Maggi, cook longer, for soupier, add a bit more water.
You can customize your Masala Maggi with other vegetables like corn, carrots, or even a fried egg on top for added protein.
